bio.text: Eileen Laubacher is the Democratic nominee for Colorado's 4th Congressional District in 2026, having advanced from the June 30 primary.
According to her campaign website, she served in the U.S. Navy for 34 years, including as an intelligence officer, and graduated from the U.S. Naval Academy in 1990.

The site says she was the U.S. Senior Defense Official and Defense Attache in New Delhi from 2019 to 2022, then Senior Director for South Asia on the National Security Council, and retired from the Navy in October 2024.
She and her husband raised five children in Colorado, according to the site.
